sar.narrative: Customer C04285, holder of card C04285-K1, is the subject of this report due to suspicious online transactions totaling $1,200.20 conducted between 2016-12-18 14:43 and 2016-12-18 14:52. Specifically, three online purchases were executed on the card within 9 minutes from the device profile 'Windows | Windows 10 | edge 17.0 | 1920x1079', consisting of $400.05 (transaction 3553899 at 14:43), $400.08 (transaction 3553904 at 14:44), and $400.07 (transaction 3553923 at 14:52). Every amount sat just below $500 and the purchases were placed minutes apart, a pattern consistent with structuring to evade reporting or authorization thresholds. When contacted by the bank, the cardholder denied making the transaction and confirmed they still physically hold the card. The activity is suspicious because it involves 3 online purchases within 9 minutes, each between $400 and $500, totaling $1,200.20. Furthermore, this behavior closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases such as CC-3841, CC-4124, CC-4086, and CC-3748, where 8 of the 8 most similar closed cases were confirmed fraud. In response to the detected fraud and exposure exceeding $1,000, the bank has recommended blocking the card, created an internal case, and escalated the matter for reporting and analyst review.
